_note: The in-game playtest (PlaytestNotes + PlaytestView + PlaytestCard). While the playtest is on, a card with the questions that fit the page you are on appears at the top of that page (never a stop, never a choice waiting, Play week is unaffected); the Playtest notes page of the menu holds every question and the quick notes. Each question: `id`, `text`, `kind` (pick = one of `options`, with an optional line for a few words whose hint is `note`; text = only the free note), `where` (the page whose card asks it: week / career:now / career:results / career:timeline / review), `min_weeks` (weeks played before it is asked) and `needs` (goals_set: a goals card has been set; goal_news: a goal was met, missed, adjusted or dropped). A card shows at most `card_max` questions at a time; Done skips what is left of them, Skip never asks them again. Answers are saved on every change in user://playtest/<run>.json and can be copied or written as text to paste into docs/PLAYTESTS.md. Written 2026-11-01 for season playtest 3; a new playtest copies this file with a new `run`.
